rows.component_basis: liquid GaO1.5 component mole fraction; two units per Ga2O3 parent, as used by Bischof
rows.parent_standard_state: pure liquid Ga2O3 on the Bischof KEMS parent standard; use the opt-in KEMS condensate table
rows.source_citation: Bischof, Sossi, Sergeev, Müller & Schmidt (2023), Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 360, 1–15, doi:10.1016/j.gca.2023.08.027
rows.source_locator: Section 4.4.4, p. 9; gamma(GaO1.5)=0.036(6) at 1700 K; Table 8 note a and source-x anchor
limitations: The gamma anchor is for the An-Di eutectic at Delta IW +1.5 to +2.5.

Table 8 reports x(GaO1.5)=0.0172 for 429 ppm, about 47 times the ordinary mole fraction reconstructed from that composition; its note says this x from the 695 ppm 2_low run is also used for 429 ppm in 1_low. Runtime x_source is calculated from caller composition on the declared GaO1.5 component basis.
